name: Transaction Identification 61
definition: Identification of the transaction for network management.

PurchaseIdentifierType.name: Purchase Identifier Type
PurchaseIdentifierType.definition: Specifies the type of identifier present in the message. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

PurchaseIdentifier.name: Purchase Identifier
PurchaseIdentifier.definition: Contains a value identifying Invoice Data or Purchase Request Data.

TransmissionDateTime.name: Transmission Date Time
TransmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time expressed in UTC of the message as sent by the initiator.|ISO 8583 bit 7

SystemTraceAuditNumber.name: System Trace Audit Number
SystemTraceAuditNumber.definition: Number assigned by a transaction originator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages within a two-message exchange (for example, request/repeat and response)|ISO 8583 bit 11.

RetrievalReferenceNumber.name: Retrieval Reference Number
RetrievalReferenceNumber.definition: A reference supplied by the system retaining the original source information and used to assist in locating that information or a copy thereof.|ISO 8583 bit 37

AssociatedData.name: Associated Data
AssociatedData.definition: Indicates that additional data will be provided in a separate addendum message.

AssociatedDataReference.name: Associated Data Reference
AssociatedDataReference.definition: Reference to additional transaction details to be conveyed separately from this message.

AssociatedDataDestination.name: Associated Data Destination
AssociatedDataDestination.definition: Destination value to be used in the subsequent addendum message.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
